rows.grounds: locative plural of compound aṣṭa-yoni indicating the eight locations
compound tad-agra referring to those foremost among them
adverbial accusative indicating the manner of worship

items.question: In what locations and by what manner must the foremost attendant goddesses be worshipped?
premises: The foremost attendant goddesses are designated as objects of worship.
The eight yonis are specified as the locations for their worship.
Circumambulation is prescribed as the manner of this worship.
items.inference: Therefore the foremost attendant goddesses must be worshipped in the eight yonis with circumambulation.
uncertainties: The precise referent of tadagrāḥ depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: The foremost among them should indeed be worshipped in the eight yonis by circumambulation.
